Seminar Title:

Asymptotic properties of nonparametric estimators of the cumulative (residual) Tsallis entropies and their quantile versions

Seminar Type:

Progress Seminar

Department:

Mathematics

Speaker Name:

Bighneswar Sahoo ( Rollno : 524ma2002)

Speaker Type:

Student

Venue:

Seminar Room (Department of Mathematics)

Date and Time:

23 Sep 2026 11 AM

Contact:

Suchandan Kayal

Abstract:

Consider the problem of estimation of the CTE and CRTE. Based on the Kantorovich metric, it is proved that the CTE and CRTE are preserved. The concepts of empirical distribution and empirical survival functions are used to obtain estimators for the CTE and CRTE. The asymptotic properties of the estimators are studied. Further, based on the kernel density estimator, the estimators of the CTE and CRTE are proposed. Their consistency properties have been examined. Estimators of the Q-CTE and Q-CRTE are constructed using the QDF estimators. It is shown that the estimators are consistent. Furthermore, the asymptotic distributions of the estimators are obtained. In both cases, simulation study is carried out. The AB and MSE values of the &nbspestimators are computed. Finally, real data sets are considered for the purpose of illustration.&nbsp
